svg.aria-label: Terminal recording of the fixlock demo: a bug fix is locked, an AI edit that would undo it is stopped, and the pull request is blocked until the owner approves.

text.tspan: fixlock demo
— what happens when an AI undoes a bug fix
A throwaway repo in /tmp/fixlock-demo-k3x9. Nothing in your projects is touched.
Abi fixes a bug: SAP rejects ISO timestamps, so dates must be sent as yyyy-MM-dd

svg.text: $ git commit -m "fix(ENG-12): send SAP DocDate as yyyy-MM-dd"

text.tspan: 🔒 FIX-001 auto-locked — src/sap/date.ts (2 lines) · send SAP DocDate as yyyy-MM-dd · linear:ENG-12
The post-commit hook locked the lines that fixed the bug, owned by Abi, linked to ENG-12.
Weeks later, Ravi's AI ports the order screen from the old portal…
…and wants to bring back the old toSapDate():
- return `${d.getFullYear()}-${p(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${p(d.getDate())}`;
+ return d.toISOString();

svg.text: AI → fixlock_check_edit (MCP; in Claude Code the pre-edit hook does this automatically)
│ • FIX-001 "send SAP DocDate as yyyy-MM-dd" (bug fix by @abinandhmj) — src/sap/date.ts lines 2-3
│ Why it exists: SAP B1 Service Layer rejects ISO timestamps for DocDate.
│ Policy: confirm with the developer; the PR will need approval from @abinandhmj.

text.tspan: The AI stops and asks Ravi. Most of the time, this is where the bug stays fixed.
Suppose Ravi says "go ahead" and commits

svg.text: │ LOCKED FIX-001 "send SAP DocDate as yyyy-MM-dd" (bug, owner @abinandhmj) — src/sap/date.ts
│ → needs approval from @abinandhmj when you open the PR, or restore these lines.
│ ! Heads up: 1 locked change(s). The commit is allowed, but CI will ask for approval.

text.tspan: A warning, never a block: local work is never stopped.
CI runs fixlock on Ravi's pull request

svg.text: │ LOCKED FIX-001 "send SAP DocDate as yyyy-MM-dd" (bug, owner @abinandhmj) — src/sap/date.ts
│ → needs approval from @abinandhmj on the PR, or restore these lines.

text.tspan: ✖ 1 locked change(s) without approval.
exit 1
→ the PR cannot merge. Git itself saw no conflict at all.
Abi gets asked to review, and decides
Either Ravi restores the line, or Abi approves the PR because the change is intended:

svg.text: │ APPROVED FIX-001 "send SAP DocDate as yyyy-MM-dd" (bug, owner @abinandhmj) — src/sap/date.ts

text.tspan: exit 0
→ merge allowed, with the owner on record.

svg.text: Without fixlock, step 3 merges silently and the SAP bug is back in production.
Try it on your repo: npx @abinandhmj/fixlock init
